text: In Arnold's geometric view, the ODE dx/dt = f(x) is best understood as:
choices: a vector field generating a flow (a one-parameter group of diffeomorphisms)
an algebraic equation with finitely many roots
explanation: The vector field f assigns a velocity at each point; its solution is the flow Phi_t, a one-parameter group with f as infinitesimal generator. It is not a single curve, a density, or an algebraic equation.
